scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix server/api
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server/api" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --cwd server/api
